get.summary: Get an access log of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.access-logs.read.

post.summary: List access logs page by page: every operation call of the caller’s side with its result, duration and client; filter by time range, trace, user, session, operation, result and status code. Requires auditing.access-logs.read.
Change the roles the current session has activated (all held right now and not violating dynamic separation of duty); returns new tokens.
Issue a captcha (4 digits, valid for one use within 5 minutes).

Third-party sign-in: exchanges the one-time ticket from the callback for the account bound in the chosen home tenant; unbound identities are rejected (sign in with a password and bind it in your profile first). Account status, lockout and two-factor apply as for password sign-in.
Lock the current session (screen lock) with a one-off lock password; afterwards every request of this session except unlock and logout is rejected with IDENTITY_DENIED_002. Requires sign-in only.

Sign in with user name and password (tenant optional; platform accounts leave it empty; when the captcha is on, include the id and code from auth.captcha). Returns a second-step ticket when the account has two-factor on, otherwise access and refresh tokens.
Sign in with the code received by email or phone; accounts with two-factor still need the second step. Anonymous.

get.summary: Sign-in page settings: available sign-in methods, third-party providers and whether a captcha is required.

post.summary: Revoke the session of the current token.

get.summary: Return the current user, tenant, session and roles.
Return the current principal's effective permissions, roles, menu tree and page codes.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for new tokens; the refresh token rotates and the old one stops working.

Send a sign-in code to an email address or phone number: the method must be enabled in the system parameter identity.login-methods; an unknown account gets the same "sent" answer (nothing is sent). Anonymous.
Second step of two-factor sign-in: send a code to the account's verified email address or phone number using the ticket from auth.login; authenticators need no code. Anonymous.

get.summary: The roles the current session holds right now and which of them are activated. Requires signing in only.

post.summary: Switch the current session to another tenant (home tenant or a tenant the user is a member of) or back to the platform (platform accounts only); returns new tokens.
Unlock the current session with its lock password; five wrong attempts in a row revoke the session (a forced sign-out). Requires sign-in only and works while locked.
Second step of two-factor sign-in: submit the code with the ticket from auth.login; returns access and refresh tokens on success.

delete.summary: Delete bot configurations in bulk. Requires notification.bot-configs.delete.

post.summary: Create bot configurations on the caller's side; codes are unique per side. Requires notification.bot-configs.create.

get.summary: Get one of the bot configurations. Requires notification.bot-configs.read.

put.summary: Edit bot configurations; the code does not change. Requires notification.bot-configs.update.

post.summary: Make an enabled entry of the bot configurations the caller's side default used for sending. Requires notification.bot-configs.update.
Page through the bot configurations of the caller's side. Requires notification.bot-configs.read.

get.summary: Get a condition hit of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.condition-hits.read.

post.summary: List condition hits page by page: access policy and permission condition hits of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.condition-hits.read.

delete.summary: Delete configuration entries on the caller’s side in bulk; built-in entries are rejected one by one. Requires settings.configs.delete.

post.summary: Create a configuration entry on the caller’s side: the key is unique per side and the value is checked against the data type; a tenant entry with a platform key overrides it (rejected when the platform entry forbids overrides). Requires settings.configs.create.

get.summary: Get a configuration entry (encrypted values are never returned). Requires settings.configs.read.

put.summary: Update a configuration entry on the caller’s side: name, group, value, default, data type, encryption, order, description and status (the key cannot change; an encrypted entry keeps its value when none is given). Requires settings.configs.update.

post.summary: List configuration entries page by page: platform principals see platform entries, tenant principals see platform entries plus their own; encrypted values are never returned. Requires settings.configs.read.

delete.summary: Delete constraint rules together with their items. Requires access.constraint-rules.delete.

post.summary: Create a constraint rule. Requires access.constraint-rules.create.

get.summary: Get a constraint rule by ID. Requires access.constraint-rules.read.

put.summary: Replace a constraint rule, including its status and items. Requires access.constraint-rules.update.

post.summary: Enable or disable a constraint rule. Requires access.constraint-rules.update.
List the constraint rules of the current side, by evaluation order by default. Requires access.constraint-rules.read.

delete.summary: Delete delegation records; an active one stops taking effect. Requires access.delegations.delete.

post.summary: Create a delegation: the delegator hands one permission or one role to the delegatee for a limited time, and must hold it now. Requires access.delegations.create.
Revoke a pending or active delegation, keeping the record. Requires access.delegations.revoke.
List the delegations of the current side with paging; their status follows from revocation and the validity window. Requires access.delegations.read.

delete.summary: Delete departments in batch; departments that still have children or members are rejected item by item. Requires organization.departments.delete.

post.summary: Create a department anywhere in the tree (code unique within the tenant; parent must exist; leader must be a user of this tenant). Tenant side only; requires organization.departments.create.

get.summary: Get a department with its ancestors, leader user name, child count and member count. Requires organization.departments.read.

put.summary: Update a department's name, leader, order, description and status (the parent is changed with departments.move). Requires organization.departments.update.

post.summary: Move a department under another parent or to the top level; moving under itself or a descendant is rejected. Requires organization.departments.update.

get.summary: The whole department tree of the current tenant with direct member counts. Requires organization.departments.read.

delete.summary: Delete dictionary items in bulk; items that still have children are rejected one by one. Requires settings.dict-items.delete.

get.summary: List all items of a dictionary (depth-first, with depth). Requires settings.dict-items.read.

post.summary: Create an item in an enabled dictionary on the caller’s side: the code is unique in the dictionary, the parent must be in the same dictionary, making it the default clears the other default. Requires settings.dict-items.create.

get.summary: Get a dictionary item. Requires settings.dict-items.read.

put.summary: Update a dictionary item: parent, name, value, description, metadata, default, order and status (the code cannot change; an item cannot move under itself or its descendants). Requires settings.dict-items.update.

delete.summary: Delete dictionaries on the caller’s side in bulk; built-in dictionaries and those that still have items are rejected one by one. Requires settings.dicts.delete.

post.summary: Create a dictionary on the caller’s side; codes are unique across platform and tenants (dictionaries are never overridden). Requires settings.dicts.create.

get.summary: Get a dictionary. Requires settings.dicts.read.

put.summary: Update a dictionary on the caller’s side: name, category, description, order and status (the code cannot change). Requires settings.dicts.update.

post.summary: List dictionaries page by page: platform dictionaries plus the caller’s tenant dictionaries. Requires settings.dicts.read.

get.summary: Get the options of a dictionary by code: tree dictionaries are flattened depth-first, disabled items are flagged, a disabled dictionary has no options. Any signed-in user.
Get a data change log of the caller’s side with field-level before and after values. Requires auditing.diff-logs.read.

post.summary: List data change logs page by page: entity inserts, updates and deletes of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.diff-logs.read.

delete.summary: Delete editions and their whitelists in batch; editions still used by tenants are rejected item by item. Requires tenancy.editions.delete.

get.summary: List every edition (by order, then code) with its whitelist size and the number of tenants on it. Platform side only; requires tenancy.editions.read.

post.summary: Create an edition with an initial whitelist (tenant-side permissions only); it can become the default edition for new tenants. Requires tenancy.editions.create.

get.summary: Get an edition with its permission whitelist. Requires tenancy.editions.read.

put.summary: Update an edition's name, description, default flag and order; the code cannot change. Requires tenancy.editions.update.

post.summary: Replace an edition's permission whitelist; the effective permissions of tenants on it narrow or widen immediately. Requires tenancy.editions.update.

delete.summary: Delete email configurations in bulk. Requires notification.email-configs.delete.

post.summary: Create email configurations on the caller's side; codes are unique per side. Requires notification.email-configs.create.

get.summary: Get one of the email configurations. Requires notification.email-configs.read.

put.summary: Edit email configurations; the code does not change. Requires notification.email-configs.update.

post.summary: Make an enabled entry of the email configurations the caller's side default used for sending. Requires notification.email-configs.update.
Page through the email configurations of the caller's side. Requires notification.email-configs.read.

delete.summary: Delete email send records in bulk. Requires notification.emails.delete.

get.summary: Get one of the email send records. Requires notification.emails.read.

post.summary: Cancel queued email send records. Requires notification.emails.resend.
Page through the email send records of the caller's side. Requires notification.emails.read.
Resend email send records: back to queued with the attempt count reset; queued and sending ones are rejected. Requires notification.emails.resend.

get.summary: Get an exception log of the caller’s side, including the full stack trace. Requires auditing.exception-logs.read.

post.summary: List exception logs page by page: unhandled exceptions of the caller’s side with type, message and location. Requires auditing.exception-logs.read.

delete.summary: Delete your export tasks together with their result files; running ones are rejected one by one. Requires sign-in.

get.summary: Get one of your export tasks. Requires sign-in.

post.summary: Cancel one of your queued export tasks. Requires sign-in.
Page through your own export tasks. Requires sign-in.

Submit an export: run a list operation's query as yourself in the background and write CSV or XLSX, kept as a temporary file for 7 days. Requires sign-in; the list operation checks its own permission as usual.

delete.summary: Delete field security rules. Requires access.field-security.delete.

post.summary: Create a field security rule: how a role, user or department reads a field and whether it may change it. Requires access.field-security.create.

get.summary: Get a field security rule. Requires access.field-security.read.

put.summary: Edit a field security rule, including enabling and disabling it. Requires access.field-security.update.

get.summary: List the entities and fields that field security can protect (registered by each package). Requires access.field-security.read.

post.summary: List the field security rules of the current side with paging. Requires access.field-security.read.

delete.summary: Delete files in a batch; stored content goes once no other file uses it. Requires files.files.delete.

post.summary: Upload one file as multipart form data (field `file`).

get.summary: Get a file. Requires files.files.read.

put.summary: Edit a file's access level, temporary flag and expiry, tags and remark. Requires files.files.update.

get.summary: Read a file's content on the caller's side, subject to its access level.

Obtain a signed download link: files open to signed-in users need only a sign-in, files that need authorization require files.files.read; the link is not checked against an identity while it is valid.

post.summary: Make a normal, verified copy the primary copy; a corrupted file becomes normal again. Requires files.files.update.
Enable or disable a copy; the primary copy cannot be disabled and a failed copy must be verified again. Requires files.files.update.

get.summary: List a file's stored copies, primary copy first. Requires files.files.read.

post.summary: Verify a copy by reading it and comparing its SHA-256; a mismatch or missing content marks it failed, and a failed primary copy marks the file corrupted. Requires files.files.update.
Abort one of your multipart uploads and discard the parts already in storage. Requires files.files.create.

Complete one of your multipart uploads: the parts in storage are assembled into the object, which is read back for its SHA-256, giving a file (content identical to an existing file on the caller's side shares that object). Requires files.files.create.
Instant upload: when a normal file with the same content already exists on the caller's side, a new record is created at once; a miss returns nothing. Requires files.files.create.
Page through the caller's side's files; the keyword matches the original name, stored name, extension, content type and tags. Requires files.files.read.
Archive or restore files in a batch; corrupted files are rejected one by one. Requires files.files.update.
Sign upload links for parts of one of your multipart uploads: the client PUTs each part to its link without credentials (at most 100 parts per call). Requires files.files.create.

Start a multipart upload: picks the upload target on the caller's side and opens a multipart upload in its storage, returning the part size and part count (for sending large files straight to storage in parts). Requires files.files.create.

get.summary: Get one of your multipart uploads and the parts already uploaded (for resuming). Requires files.files.create.
List up to 20 active users that can be impersonated in a tenant (or the platform), matched by keyword. Requires identity.impersonation.start.

post.summary: Sign in as another user: opens a separate session for the target and returns tokens carrying the actor claim. Tenant subjects stay in their own tenant. Requires identity.impersonation.start.
End impersonation: revokes the impersonation session and returns tokens for the actor's original session.
Record the result of an import (the page creates the rows one by one). Requires sign-in.

get.summary: List your most recent imports on a page. Requires sign-in.

delete.summary: Delete entries from your own inbox; the notifications themselves are unaffected. Any signed-in user.

post.summary: Confirm a notification in your inbox that asks for confirmation; it is marked read too. Any signed-in user.
Record that one of your popup notifications has been shown so it does not pop up again. Any signed-in user.

get.summary: Your unread banner notifications, shown at the top of the page. Any signed-in user.

post.summary: Page through your own inbox on the current side (published and within their visibility window): the keyword matches title and content; filter by read state and type or show only pending items. Any signed-in user.

get.summary: Your unread mandatory notifications; pages are blocked until they are read. Any signed-in user.

post.summary: Mark every visible unread entry of your inbox on the current side as read. Any signed-in user.
Mark entries of your own inbox as read. Any signed-in user.

get.summary: Your popup notifications not shown yet; each pops up once after sign-in. Any signed-in user.
The login auto-ban settings in effect and the addresses banned right now (platform only). Requires access.login-bans.read.

post.summary: Lift the ban on an address together with its failure count in the current window (platform only). Requires access.login-bans.lift.

get.summary: Get a sign-in log of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.login-logs.read.

post.summary: List sign-in logs page by page: sign-in, refresh, sign-out, tenant switch, impersonation and password change events of the caller’s side, successful or not. Requires auditing.login-logs.read.

delete.summary: Remove users from departments in batch; when a primary membership is removed the next one becomes primary. Requires organization.memberships.delete.

post.summary: Add a user of this tenant to a department, optionally with a position; the first membership of a user becomes the primary one. Requires organization.memberships.create.

put.summary: Update a membership's position, primary flag, employee number, grade, hire date and order. Requires organization.memberships.update.

post.summary: List memberships filtered by department, user, position or primary flag, with user, department and position names. Requires organization.memberships.read.

delete.summary: Delete operator nodes in batch; page nodes and directories that still have children are rejected item by item. Requires access.menus.delete.

get.summary: List the whole menu tree (hidden nodes, operator-created directories and links, and the customization flag of page nodes). Platform side only; requires access.menus.read.

post.summary: Create an operator node: a directory (top level only) or an external link (http / https, may sit in a directory); page nodes come from page registrations and cannot be created. Requires access.menus.create.

get.summary: Get one menu node. Requires access.menus.read.

put.summary: Update a menu node: page nodes only change presentation (title, icon, order, directory, visibility, caching, pinned tab) and become customized; operator nodes may also change their link and permission. Requires access.menus.update.

post.summary: Restore a page node's presentation to its registration and clear the customization flag. Requires access.menus.update.

delete.summary: Delete message templates in bulk. Requires notification.message-templates.delete.

post.summary: Create message templates on the caller's side; codes are unique per side. Requires notification.message-templates.create.

get.summary: Get one of the message templates. Requires notification.message-templates.read.

put.summary: Edit message templates; the code does not change. Requires notification.message-templates.update.

post.summary: Page through the message templates of the caller's side. Requires notification.message-templates.read.

get.summary: Your activity: sign-ins, accesses and operations today, this week and this month, the latest of each, and daily operations and accesses over the last 371 days, split by the requested time zone. Requires sign-in only.

delete.summary: Delete your open API credentials; their AppKeys stop working at once. Not available in impersonation sessions.

get.summary: List your own open API credentials (secrets are never shown). Requires sign-in only.

post.summary: Create an open API credential (at most 5 per person); the secret is returned this once only. Not available in impersonation sessions.

put.summary: Enable or disable one of your open API credentials. Not available in impersonation sessions.

post.summary: Rotate the secret of one of your credentials: the old secret stops working at once and the new one is returned this once only. Not available in impersonation sessions.

get.summary: Your call security settings: the signature algorithm and IP allow-list, applied to all your credentials. Requires sign-in only.

post.summary: Save your call security settings (replaced as a whole and applied to all your credentials at once). Not available in impersonation sessions.

get.summary: List your own sign-in logs page by page (sign-in, refresh, sign-out, tenant switch, impersonation, password change and more, successful or not), newest first, up to 50 per page. Requires sign-in only.

delete.summary: Delete your OAuth apps. Not available in impersonation sessions.

get.summary: List your own OAuth apps. Requires sign-in only.

post.summary: Create one of your OAuth apps (authorization code and refresh token, scopes openid profile email, consent required); a confidential client’s secret is returned this once only. Not available in impersonation sessions.

get.summary: Get one of your OAuth apps. Requires sign-in only.

put.summary: Update one of your OAuth apps: name, homepage, description, redirect URIs, logo and enabled. Not available in impersonation sessions.

post.summary: Reset the secret of one of your OAuth apps (public clients have none). Not available in impersonation sessions.

delete.summary: Delete notifications in bulk; published ones also leave their recipients' inboxes. Requires notification.notifications.delete.

post.summary: Create a notification draft, optionally publishing it at once: role, department and user targets need at least one ID, and departments exist only on the tenant side. Requires notification.notifications.create, plus notification.notifications.publish to publish at once.

get.summary: Get a notification with its delivery targets. Requires notification.notifications.read.

put.summary: Replace a notification draft, including its targets; published notifications cannot be changed. Requires notification.notifications.update.

post.summary: Publish a draft: resolve the active recipients of the caller's side from its targets, write their inbox entries and push them in real time after commit; a notification is published only once. Requires notification.notifications.publish.

get.summary: Read statistics: recipients, read, unread and confirmed counts. Requires notification.notifications.read.

post.summary: Page through the recipients of a published notification with their read and confirmation state; optionally only unread or unconfirmed ones. Requires notification.notifications.read.
Remind: push a published notification again to recipients who have not read it, or not confirmed it when confirmation is required. Requires notification.notifications.publish.
Page through the caller's side's notifications: the keyword matches title and content; filter by type, priority, target and published state. Requires notification.notifications.read.

delete.summary: Delete numbering rules on the caller’s side in bulk; rules that have issued numbers are rejected one by one. Requires settings.numbering-rules.delete.

post.summary: Create a numbering rule on the caller’s side: the date format must distinguish the reset cycle and the time zone is an IANA id. Requires settings.numbering-rules.create.

get.summary: Get a numbering rule, including its current period and last issued sequence value. Requires settings.numbering-rules.read.

put.summary: Update a numbering rule on the caller’s side; once it has issued numbers the format is frozen and only name, description, order, status and tenant sharing can change. Requires settings.numbering-rules.update.

post.summary: List a rule’s issue records page by page (a tenant only sees the ones it requested). Requires settings.numbering-rules.read.

Safely reset the sequence: the next value must exceed the highest value already issued in the current period (jumping forward is allowed), a reason is required and platform rules need the rule code typed back as confirmation. Requires settings.numbering-rules.reset.

Issue numbers from a rule: committed in its own transaction, numbers are consumed permanently; the same idempotency key replays with identical parameters and conflicts otherwise. Requires settings.numbering-rules.generate.
List numbering rules page by page: platform principals see platform rules, tenant principals see their own rules plus platform rules shared with tenants. Requires settings.numbering-rules.read.

get.summary: Preview numbers for a given format (pure computation, nothing is issued, up to 50). Requires settings.numbering-rules.read.

delete.summary: Delete OAuth apps in bulk (soft delete; tokens issued to them stop working with them). Requires openplatform.oauth-apps.delete.

post.summary: Create an OAuth app: the ClientId is generated when omitted and is globally unique; a confidential client’s secret is returned this once only, a public client has none (its authorization codes need PKCE). Requires openplatform.oauth-apps.create.

get.summary: Get one OAuth app (the secret is never shown). Requires openplatform.oauth-apps.read.

put.summary: Update an OAuth app (replaced as a whole, including enabled; the ClientId, client type and secret stay). Requires openplatform.oauth-apps.update.

post.summary: Reset an OAuth app’s secret: the old secret stops working at once and the new one is returned this once only; public clients have no secret. Requires openplatform.oauth-apps.update.

List OAuth apps (created by the platform or by users under My apps) page by page; the keyword matches name, description, ClientId, homepage and remark, with filters for app type, client type, enabled, skip consent and personal apps. Requires openplatform.oauth-apps.read.

get.summary: List the apps you have authorized and the scopes you granted. Requires sign-in only.

post.summary: Approve the authorization: issues an authorization code, records the consent and returns the redirect URI with code and state. Not available in impersonation sessions.
Deny the authorization: returns the redirect URI with error=access_denied and state, only when the client and redirect URI are valid. Requires sign-in only.

get.summary: Preview for the consent page: checks the authorization request (client, redirect URI, response_type, PKCE, scopes) and returns the app, the scopes and whether consent can be skipped. Requires sign-in only; not available in impersonation sessions.

post.summary: Revoke your authorization of an app: deletes the consent and revokes all of your tokens it holds. Not available in impersonation sessions.

get.summary: Get an open API log of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.open-api-logs.read.

post.summary: List open API logs page by page: signed open API calls of the caller’s side with their signature checks. Requires auditing.open-api-logs.read.
Echo: returns the request body as received, to check the content signature and encryption (the body may be AES-CBC encrypted, and the response is then encrypted too). Signed calls only.

get.summary: Signature self-check: once the signature verifies, returns the AppKey, the credential owner and the server time. Callable only with requests signed by an open API credential (X-Access-Key, X-Timestamp, X-Nonce, X-Content-Sign, X-Signature).
Get an operation log of the caller’s side, including its details. Requires auditing.operation-logs.read.

post.summary: List operation logs page by page: audited business operations of the caller’s side with their results and durations. Requires auditing.operation-logs.read.

get.summary: Get a permission change log of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.permission-change-logs.read.

post.summary: List permission change logs page by page: grants, revocations, role membership, data scope and edition changes of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.permission-change-logs.read.

delete.summary: Delete condition clauses. Requires access.permission-conditions.delete.

get.summary: List the grant bindings of a role or user and the condition clauses on them. Requires access.permission-conditions.read.

post.summary: Add a condition clause to a grant or denial: met to grant on a grant, met to deny on a denial. Requires access.permission-conditions.create.

put.summary: Edit a condition clause, including enabling and disabling it. Requires access.permission-conditions.update.

get.summary: List the condition attribute catalog (shared by permission conditions and access policies), with the operators each allows and whether it is known before authentication. Requires access.permission-conditions.read.
Impact trial: the current verdict for everyone a grant affects, up to 200 people. Requires access.permission-conditions.trial.
Condition inventory: diagnostics for every condition on the current side and the conclusion of its group. Requires access.permission-conditions.trial.
Condition trial: decide one permission for one user under the given request, explained group by group and clause by clause. Requires access.permission-conditions.trial.

List the grantable permission catalog: the caller's side by default; platform principals may pass side=tenant for the tenant side (used to edit edition whitelists); for tenant principals the catalog is narrowed by their edition. Requires access.permissions.read.

delete.summary: Delete access policies. Requires access.policies.delete.

post.summary: Create an access policy; it always starts as log only and enabled. Requires access.policies.create.

get.summary: Get an access policy by ID. Requires access.policies.read.

put.summary: Replace the content and conditions of an access policy; its action and status stay. Requires access.policies.update.

post.summary: Change the action of an access policy: log only, deny or allow. Requires access.policies.update.
Enable or disable an access policy. Requires access.policies.update.

get.summary: The condition attributes available to access policies, with the operators each allows and whether it is known before authentication. Requires access.policies.read.

post.summary: List the access policies of the current side, by evaluation order by default. Requires access.policies.read.

get.summary: List the preset access policy templates. Requires access.policies.read.

post.summary: Trial an access policy: evaluate a saved policy or draft conditions under the given request, explained group by group and condition by condition. Requires access.policies.trial.

delete.summary: Delete positions in batch; positions still referenced by memberships are rejected item by item. Requires organization.positions.delete.

post.summary: Create a position (code unique within the tenant). Requires organization.positions.create.

get.summary: Get a position. Requires organization.positions.read.

put.summary: Update a position's name, order, description and status. Requires organization.positions.update.

post.summary: List positions with paging, keyword, filters and sorting. Requires organization.positions.read.

get.summary: Your profile and account security summary (two-factor, last password change). Any signed-in user.

put.summary: Save your profile: display name, real name, gender, birthday, country or region and bio (replaced as a whole; blanks count as empty). Requires sign-in only.

post.summary: Upload the signed-in user's avatar (JPEG or PNG, at most 2 MB) as multipart form data (field `file`).

Start a binding: issues a binding intent for the signed-in user (10 minutes, single use) and returns the URL to the third-party authorization; only that user can confirm the resulting ticket. Not available in impersonation sessions.

Second step of changing your email address or phone number: confirm with the code sent to the new one, which then replaces the old one and is marked verified. Requires sign-in; not available while impersonating.
Change your own password; requires the current password and revokes your other sessions.
Change your username: requires your current password, once every 90 days, unique within your home tenant. Not available in impersonation sessions.
Turn off a two-factor method: confirm with a current authenticator code, or for email and SMS with the code sent by profile.send-two-factor-code. Not available while impersonating.

Turn on a two-factor method: confirm the authenticator with a code from the newly generated key, or email and SMS with the code sent by profile.send-two-factor-code. Not available while impersonating.

get.summary: List the third-party accounts bound to you. Requires sign-in only.

post.summary: Confirm a binding: binds the third-party account from the one-time ticket to the signed-in user; only the user who started the binding can confirm it, and it is refused when someone else has bound the account. Not available in impersonation sessions.

get.summary: Your notification preferences: in-app, email and SMS channels and announcement, task and security topics; everything is received until saved. Mandatory and emergency notifications ignore them. Requires sign-in only.

post.summary: Remove your avatar; the avatar file is reclaimed. Upload a new one with POST /api/profile/avatar. Requires sign-in only.
Sign out all your devices except the current one, including impersonation sessions you started that are still open. Requires sign-in only.
Sign out one of your devices; use sign-out for the current one. Requires sign-in only.
First step of changing your email address or phone number: checks your current password and sends a code to the new one. Requires sign-in; not available while impersonating.
Send the code for turning email or SMS two-factor on or off to your verified email address or phone number. Not available while impersonating.
Send a verification code to your current email address or phone number (to verify it). Requires sign-in.

get.summary: List your signed-in devices: all your active sessions (platform and tenants alike), the current one first. Requires sign-in only.

post.summary: Start binding an authenticator: generate a new key (confirm with an authenticator code within 10 minutes). Not available while impersonating.
Unbind one of your third-party accounts. Not available in impersonation sessions.
Save your notification preferences (replaces them as a whole). Requires sign-in only.
Confirm your current email address or phone number with the code you received and mark it verified. Requires sign-in.

delete.summary: Delete roles in batch together with their members and permissions; built-in roles cannot be deleted. Requires access.roles.delete.

post.summary: Create a role on the current side (platform or tenant); the code is unique per side and cannot be changed. Requires access.roles.create.

get.summary: Get a role with its granted permissions and member count. Requires access.roles.read.

put.summary: Update a role's name, description, order and status. Requires access.roles.update.

post.summary: Assign users to a role; users must belong to the role's side. Takes effect at the user's next token refresh. Requires access.roles.assign.
Deny permissions on a role: revokes the same grants and writes Deny rules (optional validity window and reason); a role deny only removes that role's own grants. Requires access.roles.grant.
Grant permissions to a role; codes must exist in the catalog and match the role's side. Requires access.roles.grant.

get.summary: Get the inheritance of a role: all its parents, all its children, and the grants and denials it inherits. Requires access.roles.read.
List the members of a role. Requires access.roles.read.

post.summary: Revoke permissions from a role. Requires access.roles.grant.

Set the direct parents of a role to the given set (empty removes all inheritance): its holders get the parents' grants right away, and the parents' denials apply to it too. Requires access.roles.set-parents.
Remove users from a role. Takes effect at the user's next token refresh. Requires access.roles.assign.
Change the validity window of a member assignment; expired or future assignments are dropped from decisions at once. Requires access.roles.assign.

get.summary: List the roles a user holds on the current side (platform or tenant). Requires access.roles.read.

post.summary: List roles of the current side with paging, filters, keyword and sorting. Requires access.roles.read.

get.summary: Get one session role record by ID. Requires access.session-roles.read.

post.summary: List the roles each session of the current side has activated. Requires access.session-roles.read.

Page through the online users of the current tenant: one row per active session with device, browser, masked IP, sign-in location, sign-in and last activity time and realtime presence; narrowed by data scope. Requires identity.sessions.read.
Force sign-out: revoke active sessions of the current tenant; the clients are notified in real time and sign out. Your own current session cannot be revoked here. Requires identity.sessions.revoke.

get.summary: Online overview of the current tenant: active sessions, users with an active session and users connected in real time. Requires identity.sessions.read.

delete.summary: Delete SMS send records in bulk. Requires notification.sms.delete.
Delete SMS configurations in bulk. Requires notification.sms-configs.delete.

post.summary: Create SMS configurations on the caller's side; codes are unique per side. Requires notification.sms-configs.create.

get.summary: Get one of the SMS configurations. Requires notification.sms-configs.read.

put.summary: Edit SMS configurations; the code does not change. Requires notification.sms-configs.update.

post.summary: Make an enabled entry of the SMS configurations the caller's side default used for sending. Requires notification.sms-configs.update.
Page through the SMS configurations of the caller's side. Requires notification.sms-configs.read.

get.summary: Get one of the SMS send records. Requires notification.sms.read.

post.summary: Cancel queued SMS send records. Requires notification.sms.resend.
Page through the SMS send records of the caller's side. Requires notification.sms.read.
Resend SMS send records: back to queued with the attempt count reset; queued and sending ones are rejected. Requires notification.sms.resend.

delete.summary: Delete storage configurations in a batch; the default one and those holding copies are rejected one by one. Requires files.storage-configs.delete.

post.summary: Create a local or S3-compatible storage configuration on the caller's side; the code is unique on the side and S3-compatible storage needs an endpoint and access keys. Requires files.storage-configs.create.

get.summary: Get a storage configuration (the access key is never shown). Requires files.storage-configs.read.

put.summary: Edit a storage configuration (the code stays; an empty access key keeps the current one). Requires files.storage-configs.update.

post.summary: Make an enabled storage configuration the caller's side's default; later uploads go there. Requires files.storage-configs.update.
Enable or disable a storage configuration; the default one cannot be disabled. Requires files.storage-configs.update.
Page through the caller's side's storage configurations, default first; access keys are never shown. Requires files.storage-configs.read.

get.summary: Get the tenant's own subscription: edition, expiry, effective seat and storage limits and usage. Tenant side only; requires tenancy.subscription.read.

delete.summary: Delete Telegram bots in bulk. Requires notification.telegram-bots.delete.

post.summary: Create a Telegram bot: names are unique and the token is stored encrypted; admins, the group allow-list and broadcast chats are comma-separated integer IDs, the command allow-list is comma-separated command names. Requires notification.telegram-bots.create.

get.summary: Get a Telegram bot. Requires notification.telegram-bots.read.

put.summary: Edit a Telegram bot; leaving the token empty keeps it. Requires notification.telegram-bots.update.

post.summary: Page through the platform-hosted Telegram bots; tokens are never shown. Requires notification.telegram-bots.read.

delete.summary: Remove tenant members in batch; they can no longer switch into the tenant. Platform side only; requires tenancy.tenant-members.delete.

get.summary: List a tenant's members (users whose home tenant is elsewhere and who enter it by membership) with user name and display name. Platform side only; requires tenancy.tenant-members.read.

post.summary: Add a user as a tenant member; rejected when the user is already a member or the tenant is the user's home. Platform side only; requires tenancy.tenant-members.create.

delete.summary: Delete tenants in batch and remove them from the directory; tenants that still have users are rejected item by item. Requires tenancy.tenants.delete.

post.summary: Provision a tenant: write the tenant and register it (enabled) in the tenant directory; the administrator is created with tenants.initialize-admin. Platform side only; requires tenancy.tenants.create. Without an edition the default edition applies (an error if there is none).

get.summary: Get a tenant with its administrator's user name and user count. Requires tenancy.tenants.read.

put.summary: Update a tenant's name, description, expiry and order; the name is mirrored to the directory. Requires tenancy.tenants.update.

post.summary: Move a tenant to another edition, or lift edition limits; its users' effective permissions follow the new whitelist immediately. Requires tenancy.tenants.update.
Create the first administrator of a tenant with every tenant-side permission; the password must be changed at first sign-in. Once per tenant. Requires tenancy.tenants.initialize-admin.
List tenants with paging, filters, keyword and sorting. Requires tenancy.tenants.read.

get.summary: Tenants the current user can enter (home tenant and memberships, active only) and whether the platform is available; the control center switches with auth.switch-tenant.
List every tenant's effective quotas and usage (seats, storage), optionally only those over quota. Platform side only; requires tenancy.tenants.read.

post.summary: Resume suspended tenants in batch. Requires tenancy.tenants.suspend.
Suspend tenants in batch: the directory marks them disabled, their users cannot sign in and calls carrying the tenant are rejected. Requires tenancy.tenants.suspend.

get.summary: Aggregate the logs of the caller’s side by trace, user, session or client address into one timeline, oldest first, with counts per log type. Requires auditing.traces.read.
Read a user's data scope override (tenant side only); without one the roles decide. Requires access.user-data-scopes.read.

post.summary: Set or clear a user's data scope override (tenant side only); the override replaces the roles' scopes entirely. Requires access.user-data-scopes.update.

get.summary: List the permissions granted or denied directly to a user on the current side, with windows and reasons. Requires access.user-grants.read.

post.summary: Deny permissions directly on a user; a user deny overrides every grant. Requires access.user-grants.grant.
Grant permissions directly to a user (optional validity window and reason). Requires access.user-grants.grant.
Revoke direct grants or denies of a user. Requires access.user-grants.grant.

get.summary: Read one of your own settings by scene and key; the value is empty until saved. Any signed-in user.

put.summary: Write one of your own settings by scene and key, replacing it whole or creating it; an empty value clears it. Any signed-in user.

delete.summary: Delete users in batch (soft delete) and revoke their sessions; you cannot delete yourself. Requires identity.users.delete.

post.summary: Create a user: a tenant principal creates one in its own tenant; a platform principal may name the home tenant or create a platform account. Requires identity.users.create.

get.summary: Get a user by ID; tenant principals only see their own tenant. Requires identity.users.read.

put.summary: Update a user's display name, email and phone number. Requires identity.users.update.

post.summary: Set a new password for a user, revoke their sessions and require a change at next login. Requires identity.users.reset-password.
List users with paging, filters, keyword and sorting; tenant principals only see their own tenant. Requires identity.users.read.
Lock users in batch and revoke their sessions; you cannot lock yourself. Requires identity.users.lock.
Reset two-factor for users in bulk (clears all methods and authenticator keys); you cannot reset yourself. Requires identity.users.reset-two-factor.
Unlock users in batch. Requires identity.users.lock.

access.constraint-rules.delete.description: Delete constraint rules together with their items.

access.constraint-rules.read.description: View separation of duty, mutual exclusion, cardinality and condition rules and their items.

access.constraint-rules.update.description: Edit, enable and disable constraint rules.

access.delegations.read.description: View time-limited delegations of permissions and roles between users.

access.delegations.revoke.description: End a pending or active delegation before it expires.

access.field-security.read.description: View field security rules and the entities and fields they can protect.

access.field-security.update.description: Edit, enable and disable field security rules.

access.login-bans.read.description: View the login auto-ban settings and the addresses banned for too many failed sign-ins.

access.menus.create.description: Create directories and external links in the menu.

access.menus.read.description: View the whole menu tree, including hidden and operator-created nodes.

access.menus.update.description: Change how menu nodes are presented and restore page defaults.

access.permission-conditions.read.description: View the conditions on role and user grants and the condition attribute catalog.

access.permission-conditions.update.description: Edit, enable and disable permission conditions.

access.permissions.read.description: View the permission catalog of the current side.

access.policies.create.description: Create access policies; a new policy only logs its hits until its action is changed.

access.policies.read.description: View the access policies of the current side and the preset templates.

access.policies.trial.description: Try how a saved or draft access policy decides for a given request.

access.policies.update.description: Edit access policies, switch them between log only, deny and allow, and enable or disable them.

access.roles.grant.description: Grant permissions to roles and revoke them.

access.roles.read.description: View roles, their members and their permissions.

access.roles.set-parents.description: Make roles inherit the permissions of other roles on the same side, and remove that inheritance.

access.roles.update.description: Edit role names, descriptions, order and status.

access.session-roles.read.description: View which roles each session has activated and why roles were deactivated.

access.user-data-scopes.update.description: Override a user's data scope in place of their roles' scopes, or clear the override.

access.user-grants.grant.description: Grant, deny and revoke permissions directly on users, with optional validity windows.

access.user-grants.read.description: View the permissions granted or denied directly to users.

auditing.condition-hits.read.description: View access policy and permission condition hits of the caller's side.

auditing.diff-logs.read.description: View entity inserts, updates and deletes of the caller's side with field-level before and after values.

auditing.exception-logs.read.description: View unhandled exceptions of the caller's side, including stack traces.

auditing.login-logs.read.description: View sign-in, refresh, sign-out, tenant switch, impersonation and password change events of the caller's side.

auditing.open-api-logs.read.description: View signed open API calls of the caller's side with their signature checks.

auditing.operation-logs.read.description: View audited business operations of the caller's side with their results.

auditing.permission-change-logs.read.description: View grants, revocations, role membership, data scope and edition changes of the caller's side.

auditing.traces.read.description: Aggregate the logs of the caller's side by trace, user, session or client address into one timeline.

files.files.create.description: Upload files to the caller's side, including instant upload of content that is already stored.

files.files.delete.description: Delete files on the caller's side; stored content goes once no other file uses it.

files.files.read.description: View the caller's side's files and their copies, and obtain download links for any of them.

files.files.update.description: Edit file details, archive and restore files, and manage their stored copies.

identity.sessions.revoke.description: Revoke active sessions of the current tenant; the signed-out clients are notified in real time.

identity.users.create.description: Create users in the current tenant.

identity.users.delete.description: Delete users of the current tenant.

identity.users.lock.description: Lock and unlock users of the current tenant.

identity.users.read.description: View users of the current tenant.

identity.users.reset-password.description: Reset user passwords; the user must change the password at next sign-in.

identity.users.reset-two-factor.description: Clear a user's two-factor methods and authenticator key so they can sign in with the password and enroll again.

identity.users.update.description: Edit user profiles of the current tenant.

notification.bot-configs.create.description: Create group bots on the caller's side.

notification.bot-configs.delete.description: Delete group bots on the caller's side other than the defaults.

notification.bot-configs.read.description: View the DingTalk, Lark and WeCom group bots of the caller's side; signing secrets are never shown.

notification.bot-configs.update.description: Edit group bots and choose the default bot of each provider on the caller's side.

notification.email-configs.create.description: Create SMTP configurations on the caller's side.

notification.email-configs.delete.description: Delete SMTP configurations on the caller's side other than the default.

notification.email-configs.read.description: View the SMTP configurations of the caller's side; passwords are never shown.

notification.email-configs.update.description: Edit SMTP configurations and choose the default one of the caller's side.

notification.emails.delete.description: Delete email send records of the caller's side.

notification.emails.read.description: View the email send records of the caller's side.

notification.emails.resend.description: Resend failed, cancelled or sent emails, and cancel queued ones.

notification.message-templates.create.description: Create email and SMS templates on the caller's side.

notification.message-templates.delete.description: Delete message templates on the caller's side; tenants fall back to the platform template of the same code.

notification.message-templates.read.description: View the email and SMS templates of the caller's side.

notification.message-templates.update.description: Edit, enable and disable message templates on the caller's side.

notification.notifications.create.description: Create notification drafts on the caller's side.

notification.notifications.delete.description: Delete notifications; a published one also leaves its recipients' inboxes.

notification.notifications.publish.description: Publish notifications to all users, roles, departments or chosen users of the caller's side and remind those who have not read them.

notification.notifications.read.description: View the caller's side's notifications with their read statistics and recipients.

notification.notifications.update.description: Edit notification drafts; published notifications cannot be changed.

notification.sms-configs.create.description: Create SMS provider configurations on the caller's side.

notification.sms-configs.delete.description: Delete SMS provider configurations on the caller's side other than the default.

notification.sms-configs.read.description: View the SMS provider configurations of the caller's side; access keys are never shown.

notification.sms-configs.update.description: Edit SMS provider configurations and choose the default one of the caller's side.

notification.sms.delete.description: Delete SMS send records of the caller's side.

notification.sms.read.description: View the SMS send records of the caller's side.

notification.sms.resend.description: Resend failed, cancelled or sent SMS, and cancel queued ones.

notification.telegram-bots.read.description: View the platform-hosted Telegram bots; tokens are never shown.

notification.telegram-bots.update.description: Edit Telegram bots: token, admins, group and command allow-lists, fallback reply and broadcast chats.

openplatform.oauth-apps.create.description: Create OAuth apps for single sign-on.

openplatform.oauth-apps.read.description: View the OAuth apps created by the platform and by users; client secrets are never shown.

openplatform.oauth-apps.update.description: Edit, enable and disable OAuth apps and reset their client secrets.

organization.departments.create.description: Create departments anywhere in the tree.

organization.departments.read.description: View the department tree and department details.

organization.memberships.read.description: View which users belong to which departments.

organization.memberships.update.description: Change a membership's position, primary flag, employee number, grade and hire date.

organization.positions.delete.description: Delete positions that no membership references.

settings.configs.create.description: Create configuration entries on the caller's side, including tenant overrides of platform entries.

settings.configs.delete.description: Delete configuration entries on the caller's side that are not built in.

settings.configs.read.description: View platform configuration entries and the caller's own; encrypted values are never shown.

settings.configs.update.description: Edit, encrypt and disable configuration entries on the caller's side.

settings.dict-items.create.description: Add items to enabled dictionaries on the caller's side.

settings.dict-items.delete.description: Delete dictionary items without children on the caller's side.

settings.dict-items.read.description: View the items of visible dictionaries.

settings.dict-items.update.description: Edit, move and disable dictionary items on the caller's side.

settings.dicts.create.description: Create dictionaries on the caller's side.

settings.dicts.delete.description: Delete empty dictionaries on the caller's side that are not built in.

settings.dicts.read.description: View platform dictionaries and the caller's own.

settings.dicts.update.description: Edit and disable dictionaries on the caller's side.

settings.numbering-rules.delete.description: Delete numbering rules on the caller's side that never issued a number.

settings.numbering-rules.generate.description: Issue numbers from the caller's rules or from platform rules shared with tenants.

settings.numbering-rules.read.description: View numbering rules, preview formats and read issue records.

settings.numbering-rules.reset.description: Move a rule's sequence forward past every value issued in the current period.

settings.numbering-rules.update.description: Edit numbering rules on the caller's side; the format freezes after the first issue.

tenancy.editions.delete.description: Delete editions that no tenant uses.

tenancy.editions.read.description: View editions and their permission whitelists.

tenancy.editions.update.description: Edit editions and replace their permission whitelists; tenants on them follow immediately.

tenancy.subscription.read.description: View the tenant's own edition, expiry, seat and storage usage.

tenancy.tenant-members.read.description: View which users may enter a tenant as members.

tenancy.tenants.delete.description: Delete tenants without users and remove them from the directory.

tenancy.tenants.initialize-admin.description: Create the first administrator of a tenant with every tenant-side permission.

tenancy.tenants.suspend.description: Suspend and resume tenants; suspended tenants cannot sign in.

tenancy.tenants.update.description: Edit tenant names, descriptions, expiry and order.
